description: Reads the person's own conversations with people they connected with at an event. Needs a personal connector token; a shared token reaches no conversations. With no arguments it lists up to twenty threads, person-to-person ones first: each row carries the other person's first name, the last line, when it landed, whether that line was the person's own, and how many are unread. With `firstName` or `chatId` it returns the last lines of that one conversation, oldest first, each saying whether it was theirs, what it said and when. No row carries a phone number, email address, surname, account id or photo. It reads only the caller's own conversations, checked on every call: a conversation they are not in returns NOT_PARTICIPANT. A `firstName` is matched against their own threads only: two matches return AMBIGUOUS_NAME and name neither, and no match returns NAME_NOT_IN_THREADS. Reading a conversation marks it read for that person, as opening it in the app or on the web does.

chatId.description: Optional. The id of one conversation, as a thread row from this tool gave it. When both this and firstName are sent, this one is used.

firstName.description: Optional. The first name of the person whose conversation to read, as a thread row spelled it, matched against the caller's own conversations only. Two matches return AMBIGUOUS_NAME and nothing is read.

limit.description: Optional. How many lines of one conversation to return, at most 50; 30 when absent. Not used when listing threads, which returns at most 20.

name: event_inbox
title: Read my messages
